neighbours.label: the name of a record holder in a superlative frame (largest animal = blue whale, tallest dog = wolfhound, fastest car = Veyron)
fire: The heaviest land animal alive today is the African elephant.
Scientists agree that the fastest land animal is the cheetah.
The tallest dog breed recognized by most clubs is the Great Dane.
The largest fish in the ocean is the gentle whale shark.
The biggest bird that cannot fly is the ostrich of Africa.
For years the fastest production car was the Bugatti Chiron.
The longest snake ever measured was a reticulated python.
The smallest bird in the world is the bee hummingbird of Cuba.
quiet: Our class watched an African elephant splash in the river at the park.
The zoo keeper said the cheetah sleeps most of the afternoon.
My neighbor walks her Great Dane around the block every evening.
Divers photographed a whale shark feeding near the reef last week.
A farmer near the village keeps an ostrich behind his barn.
My uncle saw a Bugatti Chiron parked outside the hotel downtown.
The pet shop down the street sells a reticulated python.
A bee hummingbird visited the feeder in our garden this morning.

notes: Probe: 'largest animal ever recorded is the blue whale' 1.01, 'Irish wolfhound is one of the tallest dog breeds' 0.41, 'Bugatti Veyron was once the fastest' 0.77; plain 'killer whale was spotted' 0.02, 'bald eagle nesting' 0.12, greyhound speeds 0.10. Superlative-frame reading is my generalisation; not directly probed.
